text:
Micro1 is Hiring for 
Senior Software Engineer,
Fully Remote, On Contract basis.

Role Description 

The Senior Software Engineer will design, build, and maintain backend services and infrastructure that power micro1’s real-world RL environments. Day-to-day responsibilities include architecting scalable systems, implementing robust APIs, optimizing performance, and ensuring reliability across distributed components. The role involves collaborating with data scientists and ML engineers to integrate models, automate workflows, and improve toolchains for experimentation and deployment. The engineer will also review code, mentor other team members, and contribute to technical decisions and best practices. This is a remote, contract role, requiring independent work, clear communication, and ownership of deliverables across the software development lifecycle.

Qualifications
 
Strong foundation in Computer Science, including algorithms, data structures, and systems design.
Proficiency in Back-End Web Development and Software Development, with experience building scalable services and APIs.
Advanced Programming skills in one or more modern languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go, C++), with a focus on production-quality code.
Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and application in large, maintainable codebases.
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization/orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
Background in or exposure to reinforcement learning, machine learning infrastructure, or data-intensive systems is highly beneficial.
Ability to work remotely, manage time effectively, and collaborate asynchronously with cross-functional teams.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Email your resume in PDF format immediately to biju49030@gmail.com

text:
We’re Hiring: AI Engineer
We are looking for a skilled AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Agentic AI and Generative AI to support the development, maintenance, and optimization of production AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience building LLM-powered applications using modern orchestration frameworks, implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model evaluation, and integrating AI agents with enterprise systems.

🔧 Key Skills Required:
 •  2–3 years of experience building production AI/ML applications or AI agents. 
  Strong experience with LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar. 
 •   Experience building Agentic AI applications and LLM-powered workflows. 
  •  Strong understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture and vector databases. 
 •   Experience with prompt engineering, prompt optimization, prompt versioning, and A/B testing. 
 •   Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks including LLM-as-a-Judge, deterministic evaluators, regression testing, and Human-in-the-Loop validation. 
 •   Experience managing AI agent memory (short-term and long-term state management). 
  •  Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool integrations, API design, and error handling. 
  •  Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript. 
  •  Experience developing and consuming REST APIs. 
  •  Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for production AI systems. 
  •  Understanding of software engineering best practices, version control, and CI/CD.

📍 Location: Kolkata, chennai, Hyderabad
💼 Experience: 8 - 10 Years

📌 Responsibilities:
   •  Own the day-to-day operations of Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions, including maintenance and enhancement of LLM/chatbot agents. 
  •  Drive regular model retraining, calibration, and optimization cycles to improve AI performance. 
  •  Design and optimize prompts, agent policies, routing logic, guardrails, safety filters, and tool integrations. 
  •  Develop offline and online evaluation frameworks, including A/B testing, regression testing, LLM-as-a-Judge, deterministic evaluators, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) reviews. 
  •  Build and operationalize scalable data pipelines using platforms such as SharePoint, Snowflake, and DataRobot. 
  •  Develop and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector stores and enterprise knowledge repositories. 
  •  Build end-to-end AI workflows integrating LLMs with enterprise APIs, Model •  Context Protocol (MCP), upstream systems, and downstream channels including web, mobile, contact center, and voice platforms. 
 
📢 If you’re excited about the opportunity, we’d love to hear from you!
